title: Cents and dollars in the same column
trigger: |values| jump > 8x between neighbouring upper quantiles of a numeric column
headsup: 15% of monthly_charges were recorded in cents (one billing region's export). The coefficient for charges collapsed to ~0 — the model concluded that price does not affect churn. No error, no warning, a clean AUC.
mitigation: Assert a plausible range per numeric column at load; plot the distribution per data source before modelling.
